t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Success in the game is reliant on your luck, therefore be quick at selecting your choices and don't overthink it

vb_textbox.text: Keep your fingers on the S and K keys to ensure you are quick enough to choose a gnome. Don't overthink it, you need to be quick and it's down to luck. Press space as soon as the basket appears, you have to be quick! Give one side a few goes then switch to the other gnome, try get into a flow and pattern.
